newsitem.title: USA: Sharpe to buy Matagorda tracts.
newsitem.headline: Sharpe to buy Matagorda tracts.

text.p: Sharpe Resources Corp said it signed a letter of intent to acquire 100 percent working interests in two Gulf of Mexico off-shore blocks from an undisclosed buyer and is planning a project expected to result in production of 10 million cubic feet of natural gas daily.
This project is particularly viable since a production platform and sales pipelines are already in place, it said.
The Matagorda natural gas field tracts are located about 16 miles off-shore Matagorda Island, Texas, in 48 feet of water, Sharpe said.
The projected production rate is from 4 wells with a 10 year life for the current development, Sharpe said.

It said this production rate will involve the recompletion of two wells and drilling two new wells to produce the proved undeveloped reserves. The project is expected to have an 8.4 month payout which includes a $3 million capital investment for a total cost of $0.20/thousand cubic feet.
The acquisition is expected to close by February 21, subject to Montreal Exchange approval.
